Name: (CP) Craftable Rings
Author: bikinavisho
Description:
Allows you to craft the vanilla rings at various Combat levels. Each ring is crafted with its corresponding gem (1) and 10 Gold Bars. 

Also has a config option to unlock the recipes for games you've already started without this mod.
